CREATE TABLE departments (

    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

);

('ليلى', 5500, 3, '2018-11-20');

FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
ORDER BY e.salary DESC;

-- GROUP BY
SELECT d.name AS department, COUNT(e.id) AS num_employees, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.id = e.department_id
GROUP BY d.id, d.name;

CREATE PROCEDURE GetEmployeesByDepartment(IN dept_name VARCHAR(100))
BEGIN
    SELECT e.* FROM employees e
    JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
    WHERE d.name = dept_name;
END //
DELIMITER ;

CALL GetEmployeesByDepartment('تقنية');

class Book
  attr_accessor :title, :author, :available

  def initialize(title, author)
    @title = title
    @author = author
    @available = true
  end

  def to_s
    "#{@title} - #{@author} [#{@available ? 'متاح' : 'معار'}]"
  end
end

class Library
  def initialize
    @books = []
  end

  def add_book(book)
    @books << book
    puts "تمت إضافة الكتاب: #{book.title}"
  end

  def list_books
    if @books.empty?
      puts "لا توجد كتب."
    else
      @books.each_with_index do |book, index|
        puts "#{index + 1}. #{book}"
      end
    end
  end

  def borrow_book(index)
    if index >= 0 && index < @books.length
      book = @books[index]
      if book.available
        book.available = false
        puts "تم استعارة: #{book.title}"
      else
        puts "الكتاب غير متاح حالياً."
      end
    else
      puts "رقم غير صحيح."
    end
  end
end

library = Library.new
library.add_book(Book.new("مقدمة في البرمجة", "أحمد"))
library.add_book(Book.new("قواعد البيانات", "سارة"))

loop do
  puts "\n1. عرض الكتب\n2. استعارة كتاب\n3. خروج"
  print "اختر: "
  choice = gets.chomp
  case choice
  when "1"
    library.list_books
  when "2"
    library.list_books
    print "رقم الكتاب: "
    index = gets.chomp.to_i - 1
    library.borrow_book(index)
  when "3"
    break
  else
    puts "اختيار خاطئ."
  end
end

responses.code:
import sqlite3
import datetime
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List, Optional

@dataclass
class Book:
    id: int
    title: str
    author: str
    isbn: str
    year: int
    available: bool
    category: str

@dataclass
class Member:
    id: int
    name: str
    email: str
    phone: str
    join_date: str

@dataclass
class Loan:
    id: int
    book_id: int
    member_id: int
    loan_date: str
    due_date: str
    return_date: Optional[str]

class LibrarySystem:
    def __init__(self, db_name='library.db'):
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(db_name)
        self.conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self.cursor = self.conn.cursor()
        self._create_tables()

    def _create_tables(self):
        self.cursor.executescript('''
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS books (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                author TEXT NOT NULL,
                isbn TEXT UNIQUE,
                year INTEGER,
                available INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
                category TEXT
            );
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS members (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                email TEXT UNIQUE,
                phone TEXT,
                join_date TEXT
            );
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loans (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                book_id INTEGER,
                member_id INTEGER,
                loan_date TEXT,
                due_date TEXT,
                return_date TEXT,
                FOREIGN KEY (book_id) REFERENCES books(id),
                FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES members(id)
            );
        ''')
        self.conn.commit()

    def add_book(self, title, author, isbn, year, category):
        try:
            self.cursor.execute(
                'INSERT INTO books (title, author, isbn, year, category) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
                (title, author, isbn, year, category)
            )
            self.conn.commit()
            print(f'✓ تمت إضافة الكتاب: {title}')
            return self.cursor.lastrowid
        except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
            print('✗ ISBN موجود مسبقاً')
            return None

    def add_member(self, name, email, phone):
        try:
            self.cursor.execute(
                'INSERT INTO members (name, email, phone, join_date) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
                (name, email, phone, datetime.date.today().isoformat())
            )
            self.conn.commit()
            print(f'✓ تمت إضافة العضو: {name}')
            return self.cursor.lastrowid
        except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
            print('✗ البريد الإلكتروني مسجل مسبقاً')
            return None

    def search_books(self, query):
        self.cursor.execute(
            '''SELECT * FROM books 
               WHERE title LIKE ? OR author LIKE ? OR category LIKE ?''',
            (f'%{query}%', f'%{query}%', f'%{query}%')
        )
        return [Book(**dict(row)) for row in self.cursor.fetchall()]

    def borrow_book(self, book_id, member_id, days=14):
        self.cursor.execute('SELECT available FROM books WHERE id = ?', (book_id,))
        book = self.cursor.fetchone()
        if not book:
            print('✗ الكتاب غير موجود')
            return False
        if not book['available']:
            print('✗ الكتاب غير متاح حالياً')
            return False
        
        loan_date = datetime.date.today()
        due_date = loan_date + datetime.timedelta(days=days)
        
        self.cursor.execute(
            'INSERT INTO loans (book_id, member_id, loan_date, due_date) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
            (book_id, member_id, loan_date.isoformat(), due_date.isoformat())
        )
        self.cursor.execute('UPDATE books SET available = 0 WHERE id = ?', (book_id,))
        self.conn.commit()
        print(f'✓ تم استعارة الكتاب. تاريخ الإرجاع: {due_date}')
        return True

    def return_book(self, loan_id):
        self.cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM loans WHERE id = ? AND return_date IS NULL', (loan_id,))
        loan = self.cursor.fetchone()
        if not loan:
            print('✗ الإعارة غير موجودة أو تم إرجاعها مسبقاً')
            return False
        
        return_date = datetime.date.today().isoformat()
        self.cursor.execute('UPDATE loans SET return_date = ? WHERE id = ?', (return_date, loan_id))
        self.cursor.execute('UPDATE books SET available = 1 WHERE id = ?', (loan['book_id'],))
        self.conn.commit()
        print('✓ تم إرجاع الكتاب بنجاح')
        return True

    def get_overdue_loans(self):
        today = datetime.date.today().isoformat()
        self.cursor.execute('''
            SELECT l.*, b.title, m.name as member_name
            FROM loans l
            JOIN books b ON l.book_id = b.id
            JOIN members m ON l.member_id = m.id
            WHERE l.return_date IS NULL AND l.due_date < ?
        ''', (today,))
        return self.cursor.fetchall()

    def close(self):
        self.conn.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    lib = LibrarySystem()
    while True:
        print('\n=== نظام إدارة المكتبة ===')
        print('1. إضافة كتاب')
        print('2. إضافة عضو')
        print('3. البحث عن كتاب')
        print('4. استعارة كتاب')
        print('5. إرجاع كتاب')
        print('6. الكتب المتأخرة')
        print('7. خروج')
        choice = input('اختر: ')
        
        if choice == '1':
            lib.add_book(
                input('العنوان: '), input('المؤلف: '),
                input('ISBN: '), int(input('السنة: ')), input('التصنيف: ')
            )
        elif choice == '2':
            lib.add_member(input('الاسم: '), input('البريد: '), input('الهاتف: '))
        elif choice == '3':
            results = lib.search_books(input('ابحث: '))
            for b in results:
                print(f"  {b.id}. {b.title} - {b.author} [{'متاح' if b.available else 'معار'}]")
        elif choice == '4':
            lib.borrow_book(int(input('رقم الكتاب: ')), int(input('رقم العضو: ')))
        elif choice == '5':
            lib.return_book(int(input('رقم الإعارة: ')))
        elif choice == '6':
            for loan in lib.get_overdue_loans():
                print(f"  {loan['title']} - {loan['member_name']} (مستحق: {loan['due_date']})")
        elif choice == '7':
            lib.close()
            break

responses.code:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

// ===== الإعدادات =====
class Config {
    private static array $settings = [
        'db_host' => 'localhost',
        'db_name' => 'cms_db',
        'db_user' => 'root',
        'db_pass' => '',
        'jwt_secret' => 'your-secret-key',
    ];

    public static function get(string $key): mixed {
        return self::$settings[$key] ?? null;
    }
}

// ===== قاعدة البيانات =====
class Database {
    private static ?PDO $instance = null;

    public static function getConnection(): PDO {
        if (self::$instance === null) {
            $dsn = 'mysql:host=' . Config::get('db_host') . ';dbname=' . Config::get('db_name') . ';charset=utf8mb4';
            self::$instance = new PDO($dsn, Config::get('db_user'), Config::get('db_pass'), [
                PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
                PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
                PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false,
            ]);
        }
        return self::$instance;
    }
}

// ===== النموذج الأساسي =====
abstract class Model {
    protected static string $table = '';
    protected static string $primaryKey = 'id';

    public static function all(): array {
        $stmt = Database::getConnection()->query("SELECT * FROM " . static::$table);
        return $stmt->fetchAll();
    }

    public static function find(int $id): ?array {
        $stmt = Database::getConnection()->prepare(
            "SELECT * FROM " . static::$table . " WHERE " . static::$primaryKey . " = ?"
        );
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        return $stmt->fetch() ?: null;
    }

    public static function create(array $data): int {
        $columns = implode(',', array_keys($data));
        $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($data), '?'));
        $stmt = Database::getConnection()->prepare(
            "INSERT INTO " . static::$table . " ($columns) VALUES ($placeholders)"
        );
        $stmt->execute(array_values($data));
        return (int) Database::getConnection()->lastInsertId();
    }

    public static function update(int $id, array $data): bool {
        $set = implode(',', array_map(fn($c) => "$c = ?", array_keys($data)));
        $stmt = Database::getConnection()->prepare(
            "UPDATE " . static::$table . " SET $set WHERE " . static::$primaryKey . " = ?"
        );
        return $stmt->execute([...array_values($data), $id]);
    }

    public static function delete(int $id): bool {
        $stmt = Database::getConnection()->prepare(
            "DELETE FROM " . static::$table . " WHERE " . static::$primaryKey . " = ?"
        );
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }
}

// ===== النماذج =====
class User extends Model {
    protected static string $table = 'users';

    public static function findByEmail(string $email): ?array {
        $stmt = Database::getConnection()->prepare("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$email]);
        return $stmt->fetch() ?: null;
    }

    public static function verify(string $email, string $password): ?array {
        $user = self::findByEmail($email);
        if ($user && password_verify($password, $user['password'])) {
            unset($user['password']);
            return $user;
        }
        return null;
    }
}

class Post extends Model {
    protected static string $table = 'posts';

    public static function withAuthor(int $id): ?array {
        $stmt = Database::getConnection()->prepare("
            SELECT p.*, u.name as author_name, u.email as author_email
            FROM posts p
            JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id
            WHERE p.id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        return $stmt->fetch() ?: null;
    }

    public static function published(): array {
        $stmt = Database::getConnection()->query("
            SELECT p.*, u.name as author_name
            FROM posts p
            JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id
            WHERE p.status = 'published'
            ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
        ");
        return $stmt->fetchAll();
    }

    public static function search(string $query): array {
        $stmt = Database::getConnection()->prepare("
            SELECT * FROM posts
            WHERE title LIKE ? OR content LIKE ?
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
        ");
        $search = "%$query%";
        $stmt->execute([$search, $search]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll();
    }
}

// ===== المصادقة =====
class Auth {
    public static function login(string $email, string $password): ?string {
        $user = User::verify($email, $password);
        if (!$user) return null;

        $payload = [
            'user_id' => $user['id'],
            'email' => $user['email'],
            'role' => $user['role'],
            'exp' => time() + 3600,
        ];

        $header = base64_encode(json_encode(['alg' => 'HS256', 'typ' => 'JWT']));
        $body = base64_encode(json_encode($payload));
        $signature = hash_hmac('sha256', "$header.$body", Config::get('jwt_secret'), true);

        return "$header.$body." . base64_encode($signature);
    }

    public static function verifyToken(string $token): ?array {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) return null;

        [$header, $body, $sig] = $parts;
        $expected = base64_encode(hash_hmac('sha256', "$header.$body", Config::get('jwt_secret'), true));

        if (!hash_equals($expected, $sig)) return null;

        $payload = json_decode(base64_decode($body), true);
        if ($payload['exp'] < time()) return null;

        return $payload;
    }

    public static function requireRole(array $user, string $role): bool {
        return $user['role'] === $role || $user['role'] === 'admin';
    }
}

// ===== وحدة التحكم =====
class PostController {
    public function index(): void {
        $posts = Post::published();
        $this->json(['posts' => $posts]);
    }

    public function show(int $id): void {
        $post = Post::withAuthor($id);
        if (!$post) {
            $this->json(['error' => 'غير موجود'], 404);
            return;
        }
        $this->json(['post' => $post]);
    }

    public function store(array $data, array $user): void {
        if (!Auth::requireRole($user, 'author')) {
            $this->json(['error' => 'غير مصرح'], 403);
            return;
        }

        $id = Post::create([
            'title' => $data['title'],
            'content' => $data['content'],
            'user_id' => $user['user_id'],
            'status' => $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
            'created_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        ]);

        $this->json(['id' => $id, 'message' => 'تم الإنشاء'], 201);
    }

    public function search(): void {
        $q = $_GET['q'] ?? '';
        $posts = Post::search($q);
        $this->json(['query' => $q, 'results' => $posts]);
    }

    private function json(array $data, int $status = 200): void {
        http_response_code($status);
        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
        echo json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_PRETTY_PRINT);
    }
}

// ===== التشغيل =====
// (يُفترض إنشاء الجداول مسبقاً)

$action = $_GET['action'] ?? 'index';
$controller = new PostController();

switch ($action) {
    case 'index':
        $controller->index();
        break;
    case 'show':
        $controller->show((int) ($_GET['id'] ?? 0));
        break;
    case 'search':
        $controller->search();
        break;
    case 'login':
        $email = $_POST['email'] ?? '';
        $password = $_POST['password'] ?? '';
        $token = Auth::login($email, $password);
        if ($token) {
            echo json_encode(['token' => $token], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        } else {
            http_response_code(401);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'بيانات خاطئة'], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        }
        break;
    default:
        http_response_code(404);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'غير موجود'], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
}

responses.code:
-- ===== إنشاء قاعدة بيانات متجر إلكتروني =====
CREATE DATABASE ecommerce_analytics;
USE ecommerce_analytics;

-- ===== الجداول =====
CREATE TABLE customers (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(150) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    city VARCHAR(50),
    country VARCHAR(50),
    registered_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE categories (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    parent_id INT DEFAULT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES categories(id)
);

CREATE TABLE products (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    category_id INT,
    price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
    cost DECIMAL(10,2),
    stock INT DEFAULT 0,
    rating DECIMAL(2,1) DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id)
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    customer_id INT NOT NULL,
    order_date DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    status ENUM('pending','processing','shipped','delivered','cancelled') DEFAULT 'pending',
    shipping_address TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id)
);

CREATE TABLE order_items (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    order_id INT NOT NULL,
    product_id INT NOT NULL,
    quantity INT NOT NULL,
    unit_price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
    discount DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 0,
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id)
);

CREATE TABLE reviews (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    product_id INT NOT NULL,
    customer_id INT NOT NULL,
    rating INT CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    comment TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id)
);

-- ===== الفهارس لتحسين الأداء =====
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer ON orders(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_date ON orders(order_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_order_items_order ON order_items(order_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_order_items_product ON order_items(product_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_products_category ON products(category_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_reviews_product ON reviews(product_id);

-- ===== Views =====
CREATE VIEW v_product_sales AS
SELECT
    p.id,
    p.name,
    c.name AS category,
    p.price,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS units_sold,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS revenue,
    COALESCE(AVG(r.rating), 0) AS avg_rating,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS review_count
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id AND o.status != 'cancelled'
LEFT JOIN reviews r ON p.id = r.product_id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, c.name, p.price;

CREATE VIEW v_customer_stats AS
SELECT
    c.id,
    c.name,
    c.city,
    c.country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS total_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS total_spent,
    COALESCE(AVG(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS avg_order_value,
    MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id AND o.status != 'cancelled'
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.city, c.country;

-- ===== تحليلات باستخدام Window Functions =====

-- ترتيب المنتجات حسب المبيعات داخل كل فئة
SELECT
    category,
    name,
    revenue,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rank_in_category,
    ROUND(revenue * 100.0 / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category), 2) AS pct_of_category
FROM v_product_sales
WHERE revenue > 0
ORDER BY category, rank_in_category;

-- تحليل نمو المبيعات الشهرية
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS unique_customers
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m')
)
SELECT
    month,
    revenue,
    orders_count,
    unique_customers,
    LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue,
    ROUND(
        (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 /
        NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 2
    ) AS growth_pct,
    SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_revenue
FROM monthly_sales
ORDER BY month;

-- ===== تحليل RFM للعملاء =====
WITH rfm AS (
    SELECT
        c.id,
        c.name,
        DATEDIFF(NOW(), MAX(o.order_date)) AS recency_days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS frequency,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS monetary
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id AND o.status != 'cancelled'
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name
),
rfm_scores AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days DESC) AS r_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency ASC) AS f_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary ASC) AS m_score
    FROM rfm
)
SELECT
    name,
    recency_days,
    frequency,
    monetary,
    r_score, f_score, m_score,
    CASE
        WHEN r_score >= 4 AND f_score >= 4 AND m_score >= 4 THEN 'أبطال'
        WHEN r_score >= 3 AND f_score >= 3 THEN 'مخلصون'
        WHEN r_score >= 4 AND f_score <= 2 THEN 'جدد'
        WHEN r_score <= 2 AND f_score >= 4 THEN 'في خطر'
        ELSE 'عاديون'
    END AS segment
FROM rfm_scores
ORDER BY monetary DESC;

-- ===== تحليل سلة السوق (Market Basket) =====
SELECT
    p1.name AS product_a,
    p2.name AS product_b,
    COUNT(*) AS times_bought_together,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_items), 2) AS support_pct
FROM order_items oi1
JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi1.order_id = oi2.order_id AND oi1.product_id < oi2.product_id
JOIN products p1 ON oi1.product_id = p1.id
JOIN products p2 ON oi2.product_id = p2.id
GROUP BY p1.id, p1.name, p2.id, p2.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY times_bought_together DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- ===== الإجراءات المخزنة =====
DELIMITER //

CREATE PROCEDURE GetTopCustomers(IN top_n INT)
BEGIN
    SELECT name, city, total_orders, total_spent
    FROM v_customer_stats
    WHERE total_orders > 0
    ORDER BY total_spent DESC
    LIMIT top_n;
END //

CREATE PROCEDURE GetProductPerformance(IN product_id INT)
BEGIN
    SELECT * FROM v_product_sales WHERE id = product_id;
END //

CREATE PROCEDURE GetRevenueByPeriod(
    IN start_date DATE,
    IN end_date DATE,
    OUT total_revenue DECIMAL(15,2)
)
BEGIN
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0)
    INTO total_revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
      AND o.status != 'cancelled';
END //

DELIMITER ;

-- استخدام الإجراءات
CALL GetTopCustomers(10);
CALL GetProductPerformance(1);

CALL GetRevenueByPeriod('2024-01-01', '2024-12-31', @rev);
SELECT @rev AS total_revenue_2024;

-- ===== التحديثات التلقائية =====
CREATE TABLE inventory_log (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    product_id INT,
    change_amount INT,
    reason VARCHAR(100),
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

DELIMITER //
CREATE TRIGGER trg_inventory_update
AFTER UPDATE ON products
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    IF OLD.stock != NEW.stock THEN
        INSERT INTO inventory_log (product_id, change_amount, reason)
        VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.stock - OLD.stock, 'تحديث المخزون');
    END IF;
END //
DELIMITER ;

class Book
  attr_accessor :title, :author, :available

  def initialize(title, author)
    @title = title
    @author = author
    @available = true
  end

  def to_s
    "#{@title} - #{@author} [#{@available ? 'متاح' : 'معار'}]"
  end
end

class Library
  def initialize
    @books = []
  end

  def add_book(book)
    @books << book
    puts "تمت إضافة الكتاب: #{book.title}"
  end

  def list_books
    if @books.empty?
      puts "لا توجد كتب."
    else
      @books.each_with_index do |book, index|
        puts "#{index + 1}. #{book}"
      end
    end
  end

  def borrow_book(index)
    if index >= 0 && index < @books.length
      book = @books[index]
      if book.available
        book.available = false
        puts "تم استعارة: #{book.title}"
      else
        puts "الكتاب غير متاح حالياً."
      end
    else
      puts "رقم غير صحيح."
    end
  end
end

library = Library.new
library.add_book(Book.new("مقدمة في البرمجة", "أحمد"))

  when "2"

    library.borrow_book(index)
  when "3"

  else
    puts "اختيار خاطئ."
  end
end

require 'sinatra'
require 'sinatra/json'
require 'sqlite3'
require 'securerandom'
require 'bcrypt'
require 'jwt'
require 'json'

# ===== الإعدادات =====
JWT_SECRET = ENV['JWT_SECRET'] || 'your-secret-key-change-me'

# ===== قاعدة البيانات =====
class Database
  def self.connection
    @connection ||= SQLite3::Database.new('app.db').tap do |db|
      db.results_as_hash = true
      db.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON')
    end
  end

  def self.migrate!
    conn = connection
    conn.execute_batch <<~SQL
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        role TEXT DEFAULT 'user',
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      );

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS posts (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        content TEXT NOT NULL,
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        status TEXT DEFAULT 'draft',
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      );

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS comments (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        post_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        content TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        FOREIGN KEY (post_id) REFERENCES posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      );
    SQL
    puts "✓ تم تنفيذ الترحيلات"
  end
end

# ===== النماذج =====
class User
  attr_reader :id, :name, :email, :role

  def initialize(row)
    @id = row['id']
    @name = row['name']
    @email = row['email']
    @role = row['role']
  end

  def self.create(name:, email:, password:, role: 'user')
    hash = BCrypt::Password.create(password)
    db = Database.connection
    db.execute(
      'INSERT INTO users (name, email, password_hash, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [name, email, hash, role]
    )
    find(db.last_insert_row_id)
  rescue SQLite3::ConstraintException
    raise 'البريد الإلكتروني مسجل مسبقاً'
  end

  def self.find(id)
    row = Database.connection.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [id])
    row ? new(row) : nil
  end

  def self.find_by_email(email)
    row = Database.connection.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?', [email])
    row ? new(row) : nil
  end

  def self.authenticate(email, password)
    row = Database.connection.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?', [email])
    return nil unless row
    return nil unless BCrypt::Password.new(row['password_hash']) == password
    new(row)
  end

  def token
    JWT.encode({ user_id: id, email: email, role: role, exp: Time.now.to_i + 3600 }, JWT_SECRET, 'HS256')
  end

  def to_h
    { id: id, name: name, email: email, role: role }
  end
end

class Post
  attr_reader :id, :title, :content, :user_id, :status, :created_at

  def initialize(row)
    @id = row['id']
    @title = row['title']
    @content = row['content']
    @user_id = row['user_id']
    @status = row['status']
    @created_at = row['created_at']
  end

  def self.all(status: nil)
    sql = status ? 'SELECT * FROM posts WHERE status = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC' :
                   'SELECT * FROM posts ORDER BY created_at DESC'
    params = status ? [status] : []
    Database.connection.execute(sql, params).map { |row| new(row) }
  end

  def self.find(id)
    row = Database.connection.get_first_row(<<~SQL, [id])
      SELECT p.*, u.name AS author_name, u.email AS author_email
      FROM posts p
      JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id
      WHERE p.id = ?
    SQL
    row ? new(row).tap { |p| p.instance_variable_set(:@author_name, row['author_name']) } : nil
  end

  def self.create(title:, content:, user_id:, status: 'draft')
    db = Database.connection
    db.execute(
      'INSERT INTO posts (title, content, user_id, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [title, content, user_id, status]
    )
    find(db.last_insert_row_id)
  end

  def self.search(query)
    q = "%#{query}%"
    Database.connection.execute(
      'SELECT * FROM posts WHERE title LIKE ? OR content LIKE ? ORDER BY created_at DESC',
      [q, q]
    ).map { |row| new(row) }
  end

  def author_name
    @author_name || User.find(user_id)&.name
  end

  def to_h
    { id: id, title: title, content: content, status: status,
      author: author_name, created_at: created_at }
  end
end

# ===== التطبيق =====
class App < Sinatra::Base
  set :host_authorization, permitted_hosts: []
  use Rack::Protection

  before do
    content_type :json
    Database.migrate! if settings.development? && !@migrated
    @migrated = true if settings.development?
  end

  # ===== المصادقة =====
  helpers do
    def current_user
      return @current_user if defined?(@current_user)
      header = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']
      return nil unless header&.start_with?('Bearer ')
      token = header.split(' ').last
      payload, _ = JWT.decode(token, JWT_SECRET, true, algorithm: 'HS256')
      @current_user = User.find(payload['user_id'])
    rescue JWT::DecodeError, JWT::ExpiredSignature
      @current_user = nil
    end

    def authenticate!
      halt 401, json(error: 'يجب تسجيل الدخول') unless current_user
    end

    def authorize!(role)
      authenticate!
      halt 403, json(error: 'غير مصرح') unless current_user.role == role || current_user.role == 'admin'
    end

    def parse_json
      JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      halt 400, json(error: 'JSON غير صحيح')
    end
  end

  # ===== المصادقة =====
  post '/api/register' do
    data = parse_json
    halt 400, json(error: 'الاسم والبريد وكلمة المرور مطلوبة') unless data[:name] && data[:email] && data[:password]

    user = User.create(name: data[:name], email: data[:email], password: data[:password])
    status 201
    json(user: user.to_h, token: user.token)
  rescue => e
    halt 400, json(error: e.message)
  end

  post '/api/login' do
    data = parse_json
    user = User.authenticate(data[:email], data[:password])
    halt 401, json(error: 'بيانات خاطئة') unless user
    json(user: user.to_h, token: user.token)
  end

  get '/api/me' do
    authenticate!
    json(user: current_user.to_h)
  end

  # ===== المقالات =====
  get '/api/posts' do
    posts = Post.all(status: params[:status] || 'published')
    json(posts: posts.map(&:to_h))
  end

  get '/api/posts/:id' do
    post = Post.find(params[:id].to_i)
    halt 404, json(error: 'غير موجود') unless post
    json(post: post.to_h)
  end

  get '/api/posts/search' do
    query = params[:q]
    halt 400, json(error: 'اكتب كلمة البحث') if query.to_s.empty?
    posts = Post.search(query)
    json(query: query, results: posts.map(&:to_h))
  end

  post '/api/posts' do
    authenticate!
    data = parse_json
    post = Post.create(
      title: data[:title],
      content: data[:content],
      user_id: current_user.id,
      status: data[:status] || 'draft'
    )
    status 201
    json(post: post.to_h)
  end

  # ===== الأخطاء =====
  error do
    json(error: env['sinatra.error'].message)
  end
end

# ===== التشغيل =====
App.run! if __FILE__ == $0
